issues.description: Stock instance method name differs between artifacts: the problem statement UML (and the reference solution) specify a method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) to append a StockIngredient to the stock's internal array, but the template Stock class implements an equivalent method named addItem(StockIngredient). This naming divergence for the same conceptual operation can confuse students (which name should they implement/use?) and may cause mismatch with tests or the reference implementation that expect addToStockIngredients.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent: either rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a new method addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) in the template that delegates to the existing addItem implementation. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to reference addItem if that name is preferred. Prefer preserving the UML and solution naming (addToStockIngredients) to avoid surprising students and ensure tests/reference code align.
